final: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) as group_avg FROM budget GROUP BY event_status), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg FROM group_avgs WHERE group_avg IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.event_status, g.group_avg, g.group_avg - o.overall_avg as diff FROM group_avgs g CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE g.group_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.event_status
